draft.title: Post Now: The New Way AI Apps Share Data
draft.script:
Ever wondered how AI apps chat with each other instantly?
A new protocol called Model Context Protocol makes this possible.
It lets different artificial intelligence tools share your files and data smoothly.
This means faster workflows and smarter assistants for everyone.
Follow @gradientailabs for daily AI news.
draft.caption: Artificial intelligence tools are finally starting to work together seamlessly thanks to new communication protocols. This update makes managing your digital workflows much faster and easier. How would you use connected AI tools in your daily routine?
